body: Implement STA-V0-002..006 and STA-V0-010 from docs/specs/spec-toolchain-adapters-v0.md: three declared OCM intent forms in internal/lrfrepo/ocm_forms.go (OIF registry) preserving OpenSpec requirement names (OSR- sha256 IDs, nativeNames envelope) and Spec Kit FR-/SC- IDs (NEEDS CLARIFICATION excluded, nativeStatus), plus minimal upstream-valid fixture projects under interop/spec-toolchains/fixtures/ (add to .corvint/test-read-scopes.json).
